nom: medicube Zero Pore SA Clear Capsule Facial Deep Cleanser

segments.oily: An oily-skinned reviewer trying to control an oily face reports noticeably less midday shine and reduced need for blotting papers within days of starting; one reviewer with a different skin type speculates the product is probably better suited to oily skin.
segments.dry: One reviewer with extremely dry skin and rosacea reports no irritation and a gentle lather, while another reviewer describes the product leaving combo/dry skin feeling dried out and dull afterwards.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers report the wash clears breakouts and reduces redness without leaving skin dry or stripped, though one combo-skin reviewer found it drying and dulling.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers, including one with rosacea and one who previously relied on Cetaphil, report no irritation, effective cleansing of deep pores and blackheads, and skin left neither too oily nor too dry.

concerns.spots: A reviewer with deep pores and stubborn blackheads reports the cleanser was a game changer for surfacing and clearing them, and another reviewer describes stubborn clogged pores being surfaced after weeks of buildup.
concerns.blemishes: Acne-prone reviewers report reduced severity and frequency of stress-related breakouts and mascne, and clearer skin with less redness overall; no reviewer reports new breakouts from use.
concerns.redness: A reviewer with rosacea reports no irritation and healthier-looking skin after one wash, and another combination-skin reviewer reports reduced redness with regular use.
concerns.dehydration: One reviewer says the cleanser is not drying or stripping when followed by hydrating products, but another with combo/dry skin reports it left skin dried out and dull afterward — a direct point of disagreement.
concerns.oiliness: An oily-skinned reviewer reports a clear reduction in midday shine and less need for oil blotters within days of use.

aspects.libelle: Thick paste texture, hard to dispense
Leaves skin feeling clean without over-drying
Can leave skin dried out and dull

extraits.texte: I love medicube. I got this to shrink and clean my pores. Feels good while washing but afterwards my skin felt dried out and dull. Probably good for oily skin. Not good for combo or dry skin.

I'm a 30 year old male who is new to skincare, trying to cure an incredibly oily face. I just got this product in 2 days ago, and I am already noticing an incredible difference. These last couple days I have not had to use oil blotters/wipes until the end of my work day, which for me so far is really good. The only reason why I didn't give 5 stars is bc I'm still navigating it. So far, I'm incredibly impressed and the feeling after use is incredible.

I have rosacea and extremely dry skin and this facail cleanser is gentle on my face doesn't cause any irritation. My face looks so much healthier after one wash! I finished the fisrt tube and will be buying again!! It has a gentle lather ans has a very pleasent clean scent. Overall this has been the best facial cleanser I've ever used 10/10!

(my skin type: combo, semi-sensitive) i have acne prone skin, and during stressful times i will occasionally break out (and get mascne from healthcare field) I have been using this 1x a week for about a month or so, this helped reduce the severity and amount of breakouts i have. this cream itself is smooth and lathers really well— a little goes a long way. It has some microfine texture to it but its barely noticeable. this was not drying at all/stripping as long as you use the right after products to rehydrate your skin. i had some stubborn clogged pores that were sitting under my skin for weeks and this helped surface them. really good and high quality product.

I love this wash. after hero cosmetics stopped producing their exfoliating jelly cleanser I was on the hunt for something that worked the same. I have acne prone, combination skin. this has worked wonders for clearing and reducing redness. I have tried all the clinique washes, as well as the gentler brands like Cetephil and CeraVe. nothing has worked like this. I don't gate keep, but i hope it never sells out.

extraits.titre: I would buy this product again and again
extraits.texte: I have such sensitive skin and would use cetaphil as a face wash. I have deep pores and stubborn blackheads and this product has been a game changer. Medicube in general has been a life saver

extraits.titre: I will definitely buy this again!
extraits.texte: I've been searching for a cleanser that was deep cleaning and I'm happy to say that I finally found one that works well with my sensitive skin. I only need to use it once a day in my skincare routine and then by my skin feels pretty clean. Not to oily or dry but just right.
